response.headline: Amazon cloud unit's AI revenue run rate exceeds $15 billion, CEO says

The numbers are also "ascending rapidly", Amazon CEO Andy ​Jassy said in a letter to shareholders, adding that its cloud business as a whole would be growing even faster without the capacity constraints that the tech industry is currently facing.  Jassy also said the annual revenue ‌run rate for Amazon's ⁠chips business, which produces its Graviton and Trainium processors, is now over $20 billion, doubling from the $10 billion milestone ⁠the company reported earlier this year.
